blurb:
From the creators of the now world famous Hop Hop Sessions boat party comes the only party boat with this kind of ambiance departing from Miami. Be ready to party and have an EPIC time on this 3.5 hour trip that includes open bar  (all you can drink)!

Our guests DJ's will welcome you with magnificent Hip Hop, R & B, afro beats, so you can enjoy the ride to one of the most beautiful waters in the world, where you will be able to enjoy the breeze and take the music in . Enjoy snacks while on board, champagne showers, fun company and party until sunset, enjoy the ride back to our starting point where the party is just beginning.  NOTE: THIS IS AN ADULT ONLY ACTIVITY  21 AND OVER.
